title: MetadataResult
description: Structured output for scripts/enrich_post.py. Sent to the API as output_config.format.schema; the categories enum is injected from data/taxonomy-policy.yaml at call time. Length and count rules are enforced locally because structured outputs do not guarantee them.

title.description: Article title in the article language. Used only when the author left the title empty.

description.description: Faithful SEO description, 150 to 160 characters, in the article language.

summary.description: One or two sentences for article cards, worded differently from the description.

keywords.description: 5 to 8 search phrases that the article actually covers.

categories.description: One or two categories from the allowed list.

tags.description: Up to 7 technically relevant tags; fewer for short articles.

series.description: Series name stated in the article, or an empty string.

series_order.description: Position in the series stated in the article, or 0.
